messages.subject: Ironhold - internal strategy note
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

Quick internal steer. The Bank is supportive but will want a price for the covenant reset and new money - expect them to push margin and fees hard. Our leverage is that they don't want to enforce into a fastenings/fluids business in this market. Hold the line on the equity cure and the amortisation holiday; give ground on margin and the amendment fee if needed. Let's not concede the shareholder debt-for-equity split until we've seen the IBR.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
